note: What a client sends first. It arrives before the connection has a cipher state, so the payload travels in the clear apart from the proof.

fields.name: marker
fields.note: Purpose undetermined. The same three bytes appear in every message of the exchange, in both directions.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: Which seat in the match the sender occupies, counted from zero.

fields.name: playerId
fields.note: Who the sender claims to be. The proof is what settles the claim.

fields.name: version
fields.note: The client's version with its separators removed, so 4.20.0.315 arrives as 42000315.

fields.name: proof
fields.note: The player identifier enciphered under the key both ends already hold. Deciphering it and finding the identifier beside it is what shows the sender holds the key.

fields.name: unknown
fields.note: Purpose undetermined, and not read by any implementation observed.
